changeHypothesis.summary: Polysilicon prices rose roughly 25-45% in Q1 as inventory disappeared. Tongwei had unusually low polysilicon costs, locked 2021 volume and expanding capacity, making it a stronger structural expression than downstream PV. But the broad PV basket was adverse and no pre-Mar26 2021 reported earnings existed to qualify for a company-engine override.

disconfirmingEvidence: PV basket was adverse by Mar26.
